title: DOE using the alien motif as cover

tellings.quote: There's something going on with high energy physics, the Department of Energy, I think, throwing people off actually with this sort of alien motif,

plain: The Department of Energy may be using the idea of aliens to throw people off what is really going on, something to do with high-energy physics, Michels suggests. It is his own hunch, offered without a source in an episode about a Secretary of Energy speaking on UFOs, and if true it would mean the alien story is partly a cover for secret physics.
